title: fix(drivers): retire the activation ledger's old two-part unique on upgraded MongoDB and MariaDB databases
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TaisqnZAQPQtcqkqYZxemz)_

Fixes #31732

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：升级来的 MongoDB 库在同步时会删掉激活台账旧的两段唯一索引(先确认三段新键和"无包行"保护索引都在，再删);MariaDB 现在也能建"无包行"保护索引(一个不可见的生成列加唯一键),于是 `os migrate plan` 会把旧索引报成安全替换。
- 为什么改：S1(#31727)把台账唯一键扩成 `(metadata_type, package_id, name)`,但这两种升级来的库会留着旧的两段索引，史诗后续子卡第一次写第二个包的同名行就会被拒。本卡要在那之前把它安全换掉。
- 风险与回滚：只删本驱动自己建、且已被更宽声明取代的唯一索引;无包行"每项一行"始终由存储强制(先建后删)。新列为 INVISIBLE,任何读都看不到。回滚即 revert;已删的旧索引不需要恢复(放宽键不丢行)。
- 先看:`packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-schema.ts` 的 `retireWidenedUniques`、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/activation-ledger-packageless-index.ts` 的 MariaDB 分支、`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts` 的 `parseHashShadowRowScope`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-mongodb exec vitest run src/mongodb-activation-ledger-packageless.test.ts`,预期 10 条通过(另 4 条真实 mongod 用例需 `OS_TEST_MONGODB_MEMORY_SERVER_ENABLED=1`)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **MongoDB: a widening arm in schema sync** (`driver-mongodb`, `retireWidenedUniques`). After the create loop, schema sync drops a unique an earlier declaration built once a declared key has widened it. It mirrors driver-sql's `widenedUniqueReplacements` and is create-before-drop. Every condition is required:
  - the declared index is unnamed, `unique: true` or `'global'`, with 2 to 8 fields;
  - the narrower index's fields are an in-order proper subsequence, under this driver's generated name (`idx_<fields>_unique`);
  - no current op asks for that name (field-level uniques included);
  - it is this driver's own shape: the NULL-distinct partial filter (#29278) or the sparse shape before it, never an index with other options;
  - the wider unique is confirmed present, with this driver's shape;
  - when a gained field is not `required`, a partial unique on exactly the narrower fields stands, whose filter tests each such field for `null`. The ledger's guard `uniq_sys_metadata_activation_packageless` is built in the same loop. Without it the old index is KEPT.
  - One `warn` line per retired index names the collection, the old key and the new key. The plain read index over the old fields stays: it refuses nothing, and the planner still answers the ledger's `(metadata_type, name)` lookup with it (measured).
  - `syncCollectionSchema` takes an optional `{ logger }`; the default writes through `console.warn`, as `SqlDriver`'s default logger does. It is not exported from the package root.
- **MariaDB: the package-less guard** (`metadata-protocol`, `ensureActivationLedgerPackagelessIndex`). MariaDB refuses both S1 forms (partial `WHERE` and functional key part, `ER_PARSE_ERROR`, measured on 11.8). The guard there is one `ALTER TABLE`: an INVISIBLE generated column `uniq_sys_metadata_activation_packageless__hash VARBINARY(32) AS (CASE WHEN package_id IS NULL THEN unhex(sha2(concat(metadata_type, 0x1f, name), 256)) END) VIRTUAL INVISIBLE`, plus `UNIQUE KEY uniq_sys_metadata_activation_packageless` over it.
  - MariaDB is told apart by `SELECT VERSION()`. An unreadable version takes the MySQL form, as before.
  - A second boot answers `ER_DUP_FIELDNAME`; the migration then adds the key alone, and `ER_DUP_KEYNAME` reads as in place.
  - Existing duplicates answer `ER_DUP_ENTRY`, reported as `conflict` with the listing query, and nothing is deleted (the S1 path).
  - The new statement builders are module exports only; the package root is unchanged.
- **driver-sql reads that guard as a partial unique** (`schema-drift.ts`, `sql-driver-introspection.ts`). The carrier column is named as a #11627 hash shadow (`hashShadowColumnFor`: index name + `__hash`), so the orphan-column pass already leaves it alone. On the S1 tree the index itself read as a DESTRUCTIVE orphan `drop_index` keyed `(package_id, metadata_type, name)`, and the old two-part index stayed KEPT (measured). Now:
  - `parseHashShadowRowScope` reads a `case when <col> is null then <digest> end` expression's scope column. `parseHashShadowKeyParts` returns the digest's parts alone, so every reader (the differ, the duplicate decorator, the shadow-state check) sees `(metadata_type, name)`.
  - `resolveHashShadowKeys` marks such a carrier `partial: true`. A partial index is runtime-managed (`isSyncReproducibleIndex`), so it is never an orphan.
  - `hasPartialUniqueGuard` compares the enforced key (`enforcedIndexKey`), so the carrier counts as the widening arm's guard. The old index then reads as one `replace_unique_index`, category safe, exactly as on SQLite and PostgreSQL.

## Why

S1 (#31727) widened the ledger's unique key to `(metadata_type, package_id, name)`. Two kinds of upgraded database keep the old `(metadata_type, name)` unique beside it:
- a MongoDB collection, because schema sync only creates indexes and never drops one;
- a MariaDB table, because MariaDB has neither form S1's guard needs, so the old index had to stay.

There, the first row a second package writes under an existing name is refused (`E11000` or `ER_DUP_ENTRY` on the old index). The epic's later child cards write exactly those rows. This PR retires the old index safely before they land, and the package-less "one row per item" rule stays enforced by the store throughout.

## Step 0 (measured on `main` 5b7269ff, Docker in the card container: MariaDB 11.8.9, mongod 8.0.34)

| Store | Reading before this PR |
|:--|:--|
| MongoDB, upgraded collection | old `idx_metadata_type_name_unique` stands beside the new key and the guard; a second package's row of a name is refused `E11000` on the old index (package-less, alpha, beta all refused) |
| MongoDB, old index dropped by hand | package-less second row refused by the guard; two packages admitted; one package twice refused by the new key |
| MariaDB, partial `WHERE` / functional key part | `ER_PARSE_ERROR` both |
| MariaDB, INVISIBLE generated column + UNIQUE key | builds; refuses a second package-less row on insert and on update to NULL; admits two packages once the old index is gone; absent from `SELECT *` and `driver.find`; drift on the S1 tree: one destructive orphan `drop_index` on the guard, old index still kept |

## Tests

- `driver-mongodb` `mongodb-activation-ledger-packageless.test.ts` (shared harness file, new top-level describes):
  - recording `Db`, every lane, 8 cases: upgraded collection retires the old unique after both creates, with one log line naming collection, old key and new key; the pre-#29278 sparse shape retired too; CONTROL fresh collection (nothing dropped, no log); CONTROL narrower unique still declared (kept); nullable gained field with no guard (kept); required gained field (retired); a same-name index this driver did not build, or a wider key not present (kept); a named declaration (claims nothing).
  - real mongod, opt-in: an upgraded collection synced twice through `MongoDBDriver`; old unique gone, new key + guard + read index stand; package-less second row refused, two packages admitted, one package twice refused.
- `driver-sql` `sql-driver-widened-declared-unique.test.ts` (shared harness file): 4 pure cases (the scope and key parts of MariaDB's stored expression, an ordinary shadow unchanged, the row-scoped carrier counts as the guard, an unscoped carrier does not), plus a live MariaDB cell (`MYSQL_CELL`, skipped on MySQL with `ctx.skip`): upgraded table, plan = one safe replace and nothing else, apply with no `allowDestructive`, re-plan empty, refusals asserted as `ER_DUP_ENTRY` naming the index, the carrier absent from `driver.find` and `SELECT *`, a second boot draws no drift.
- `metadata-protocol` `activation-ledger-packageless-index.test.ts`: new describe, 6 cases (carrier name = driver-sql's shadow name, the exact statement, MariaDB takes it and never the MySQL statement, second boot re-key path, conflict, MySQL still takes its functional form).
- **Forced test edits:**
  - `activation-ledger-packageless-index.test.ts`: the case titled "a dialect with neither form (MariaDB) is unsupported" is retitled "a server with no form at all (MySQL before 8.0.13, version unreadable)". Its body is unchanged: MariaDB is no longer that case.
  - `activation-ledger-packageless-index.live-dialects.test.ts`: the MySQL/MariaDB case asserted `unsupported` on MariaDB. It now asserts `created` on both and, on MariaDB, that the carrier is absent from `SELECT *`. The header line saying MariaDB builds nothing is corrected.
  - `mongodb-activation-ledger-packageless.test.ts`: the shared mongod is stopped once in a module-level `afterAll` instead of in the first real-server describe's, so the second real-server describe can use it.

## Acceptance notes

- **MySQL is unchanged**: it keeps S1's functional key part (one extra `SELECT VERSION()` read before it). Its old index is a hash-shadow carrier that the widening arm never claims (S1's reading, untouched here).
- **MariaDB before 10.3** has no INVISIBLE column, answers `unsupported`, and keeps the old index (the S1 behaviour).
- **The memory driver** stays the stated gap S1 recorded.
- **File surface**: all inside the claim (driver-mongodb schema sync; driver-sql's MariaDB arm, i.e. the row-scoped shadow reading in `schema-drift.ts` and `sql-driver-introspection.ts`; the package-less migration; tests; the changeset).

## Verification

Head f28a8b80 on base 5b7269ff (S1's merge). Live servers ran in Docker in the card container: MariaDB 11.8.9, MySQL 8.4.13, mongod 8.0.34.

- Package suites: driver-sql + driver-mongodb, 4194 passed / 224 skipped; metadata-protocol, 22616 passed / 29 skipped.
- Touched files, live:
  - driver-sql widened file on MariaDB: 14 of 14.
  - The same file on MySQL 8.4: 13 passed, and the MariaDB cell is skipped as designed.
  - metadata-protocol unit + live-dialects on MariaDB: 20 passed. Only the PostgreSQL cases are skipped.
  - The live-dialects MySQL / MariaDB case on MySQL 8.4: green.
  - mongo ledger file with real mongod: 14 of 14 (without it, 10 passed and 4 skipped).
- Dogfood, under the verify lock:
  - Files: `activation-ledger-package-key`, `activation-ledger-actor`, `packaged-activation-ledger-reach`, `upgrade-18x-harness`, `upgrade-18x-index-equivalence`.
  - Result: 5 files, 52 passed, 1 skipped.
  - The `showcase_invoice` schema-sync error lines in that log are sqlite-wasm's non-constant default, which this PR does not touch.
- Full `pnpm build`: 119 of 119 tasks.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: green (122 entries, 72 packages).
- `check:driver-conformance`: 66 covered, 6 DEBT on head, and the same 66 and 6 on base.
- eslint over the three packages, repo spelling (`--no-inline-config`): exit 0. None of the three has a `lint` script of its own (`pnpm --filter … lint` answers `ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_NO_SCRIPT`).
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 69 derived, 69 run, each with its exit code, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
  - Two gates first answered exit 3 on the shallow clone and were re-run green. Teardown self-test: after fetching its pinned ref. Dual-build: after the full build.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each was red, then restored with `git diff HEAD` empty):

| # | Mutation | Red test |
|:--|:--|:--|
| C1 | introspection never marks the row-scoped carrier `partial` | live MariaDB plan/apply/re-plan |
| C2 | key parts read from the whole expression, scope column included | scope parse + live plan |
| C3 | guard check compares raw columns, not the enforced key | carrier-counts-as-guard + live plan |
| C4 | MariaDB never detected | MariaDB takes the INVISIBLE form; second-boot re-key |
| C5 | column built VISIBLE | exact statement; live-dialects `SELECT *` keys |
| C6 | `ER_DUP_FIELDNAME` rethrown | second-boot re-key; live-dialects second boot |
| C7 | Mongo guard requirement removed | nullable gained field with no guard keeps the old unique |
| C8 | Mongo narrower-index shape check removed | foreign same-name index kept |
| C9 | still-declared check removed | CONTROL still-declared kept |
| C10 | wide-index presence check removed | wide key missing keeps the old unique |
